column1: # The sun-sanity pass's excused groups (SunSanity.kt, Excuse): breaches the engine's own day accounts for, pinned like
# an open finding so a new one, or one that grows, fails the pass. A Dhuhr before transit or a Maghrib before sunset
# is never excused and never listed: the engine's own floor forbids both (ruling R180). Ruling R265's checks (an Asr
# before its shadow, a sunrise or Fajr's end after the real sunrise, Dhuhr's end after the first shadow) are listed here
# only with the day's own excuse: the floor stands aside where a rule sets the day's Asr or the day is polar, and the
# sunrise stays a minute after a Fajr shown at or just before the sun; unexcused, either fails the pass. The first two
# 2026-11-12..2027-12-31 (run of 12 Nov 2026, found again unchanged with the floor in); ceilings: worst_s is the worst
# seconds found rounded up plus one second for the window's drift from year to year, points the number of points found.
